latest_release.body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.25

Released on 2026-11-08.

Re-rendering a film with the same settings now gives the same result, because every render seeds its random values. A muted video's picture also no longer waits on its own audio track at a cut, and `check` replays an unchanged project's last pass.

## Features

- **CLI:** Check replays an unchanged project's last pass and takes --no-craft ([070b964d7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/070b964d7b8cd844a893f0abbe8e0b7f1ac6d879), [#7398](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7398)).

## Fixes

- **Core:** A muted video's picture no longer waits on its own audio track at a cut ([fa2e63515](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fa2e63515f3a4b80c7f0399c4f393a9a4c6f6d3f), [#7412](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7412)).
- **Producer:** Seed random values in every render so re-renders give the same film ([eb16510a1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/eb16510a10fbc30f230ae2b7d6e5a7ac50e31eeb), [#7410](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7410)).
- **Core:** Capture pages load only the clips on screen ([12906e0bf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/12906e0bfba41b72d9aad83d6a98c0c8943e5682), [#7402](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7402)).

## Internal

- Install ffmpeg through the GitHub API asset route with a cache ([074de9dd1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/074de9dd1e7196c1e1f56b6c8704f4bebac41983), [#7401](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7401)).

## Full changelog

Download the desktop app: macOS · Windows · Linux (.deb)

HyperFrames is a free, open-source framework for turning HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. Use it locally with the CLI, from AI coding agents with skills, or as the rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows. The [HyperFrames Studio app](https://hyperframes.heygen.com/studio-app) is free to use as well; its [Pro plan](https://hyperframes.studio/pricing) adds HeyGen's top video, image, voice and music models.
